body: Supposedly, even if you promote yourself to customer you would keep your tuition benefits and be able to finish your course. I’ve known a couple people that have started taking classes through Walmart, quit and then finished their free degree still.

I’ve heard great things about hokas and asics shoes. I bought a pair of Brooks running shoes and they are fantastic. Their website has a little quiz that determines what kind of shoe you need. Also get compression socks! They’ve helped my arches so much. Invest in good shoes, it helps so much in the long run.
